verdicts.reason: Both 320x50 strips are nearly the same layout. The legal fine print opens the left side at a size close to the body copy, so it is the first thing read and competes with the message. The SOLSTICE logo is a faint speck on the dark background, so the brand is effectively lost. The phone is shrunk to an illegible thumbnail with the LONGEST DAY SALE ribbon crammed onto or against it, and that ribbon's text is unreadable. The only real difference: A sets the legal text in 3 lines with the ribbon cutting over the phone's corner, while B uses 4 narrower lines and puts the ribbon beside the phone. B's ribbon collides slightly less, but the legal block is busier, so neither is meaningfully better. In both, the headline, 25% off line and Claim the Deal button read fine left to right.
